headline: Ardagh Metal Packaging Upgrades Guidance as European Expansion Accelerates
summary: Ardagh Metal Packaging upgraded its full-year earnings guidance following accelerated manufacturing capacity expansion across its European operations.
why: Packaging suppliers are linked to consumer beverage production volumes and industrial input supply chains.

impacts.name: Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A.
impacts.why: Upgraded guidance reflects improved volume growth and operational leverage across European facilities.
